name: What is the recommended R-value for attic insulation in Southern California?

mainEntity.name: What is the recommended R-value for attic insulation in Southern California?

acceptedAnswer.text: For homes in climate zones like Southern California, including cities such as Orange and Mission Viejo, the U.S. Department of Energy generally recommends an R-value between R-30 and R-60 for attic insulation. The R-value indicates the insulation's resistance to heat flow; a higher number means better insulating power. Your specific needs may vary based on your home's age, existing insulation, and specific energy goals. A professional assessment can determine the optimal R-value for your property.
acceptedAnswer.description: In Southern California, an R-value between R-30 and R-60 is generally recommended for attic insulation to ensure energy efficiency.
